summary: Brittle Star Time I4 now stands a Ruby disc of Headlong's hedge slabs across the way into every ring and along the return straight (11 discs, 749 slabs a lap); a Brittle Star rams through at its own kit's speed cost or shoots a hole first; the discs stand back up once no hull is within 60 u, and a broken slab or let-go post now returns to the prism pool
why: Yash: 'Intensity 4 environment needs to be more filled along the flight path, brittle star need to break through obstacles to pass rings'
